contentSections.heading: Overview & Key Highlights
paragraphs: Sarojini Nagar is renowned as Delhi's budget fashion capital. From trendy export surplus clothing and footwear to accessories and home decor, this market offers unmatched variety at fraction of retail prices.
In this 2024 guide, we share key insider tips to help you navigate Sarojini Nagar effectively or shop live remotely with a local Monkey.
bullets: Export surplus fashion starting as low as ₹100
Best days to visit: Tuesday to Friday morning hours
Metro access: Sarojini Nagar Metro Station (Pink Line) Gate 2

contentSections.heading: Top Shopping & Bargaining Tips
paragraphs: Bargaining is essential in Sarojini Nagar. Vendors usually quote 30-40% higher than their actual sell price. Always inspect garments for small defects or missing buttons before finalizing payment.
contentSections.quote: Pro Tip: Always carry cash and a sturdy cloth bag, as vendors charge extra for polythene carry bags.

faqs.question: Is Sarojini Nagar Market open on Mondays?
faqs.answer: Official market shops remain closed on Mondays, though a few street vendors operate near Metro Gate 2.

faqs.question: Can I shop remotely from Sarojini Nagar using Market Monkey?
faqs.answer: Yes! Market Monkey connects you with verified local Monkeys who stream live video from the market, bargain for you, and ship your purchases.

faqs.question: What is the price range for clothes in Sarojini Nagar?
faqs.answer: Tops and t-shirts range from ₹100 to ₹350, dresses from ₹250 to ₹600, and jackets/coats from ₹400 to ₹1200.
